title: Plakar Google Photos Importer Connector Config

location.description: Google Photos location URI, always gphotos://

credentials_file.description: Path to the OAuth2 client JSON (Desktop app) downloaded from the Google Cloud console

credentials_json.description: The OAuth2 client JSON content, inlined

token_file.description: Path to the OAuth2 token JSON. Created by the consent flow on first use if it does not exist

token_json.description: OAuth2 token JSON content holding at least a refresh_token

refresh_token.description: A bare OAuth2 refresh token, used together with the client credentials

access_token.description: A bare OAuth2 access token; it is not refreshed when it expires

sessions.description: Number of picking rounds. Each round opens a new picker session for up to max_items items

max_items.description: Maximum number of items that can be picked per session (Google caps this at 2000)

layout.description: Snapshot layout: 'date' files items under /YYYY/MM, 'flat' puts everything at the root

endpoint.description: Override the Google Photos Picker API endpoint (testing only)
